name: ROSGZ
tagline: Connecting robotics developers in Guangzhou, advancing technical exchange and innovation
description: ROS Guangzhou is an open technical community for robotics developers. We connect developers, researchers and founders working on robotics, autonomous driving, AI perception and embodied AI in and around Guangzhou. Built on ROS / ROS 2, the community runs online discussions and offline events to promote knowledge sharing, open-source collaboration and hands-on engineering practice.
vision: Connect robotics developers in Guangzhou and advance technical exchange and innovation. ROS has become essential infrastructure for robotics worldwide, yet local developers in many cities are still weakly connected. ROS Guangzhou aims to build a long-term, open, technology-driven community where robotics developers can share experience, exchange ideas, showcase projects and find collaboration opportunities — making Guangzhou one of the most active cities for robotics exchange.
positioning: A developer-driven technical community focused on the practice and exchange of robotics technology.
principle: Technology exchange first: no paid training, no recruiting agency, no advertising.

activityFormats.title: Tech Talks
activityFormats.desc: Community members share ROS development experience, robot system architecture, SLAM / CV / AI algorithm practice and open-source robot projects.

activityFormats.title: Developer Meetups
activityFormats.desc: Regular offline gatherings: ROS developer meetups, robotics technical exchanges, project demos and discussion.

activityFormats.title: Hackathons / Workshops
activityFormats.desc: Hands-on practice that builds collaboration: ROS development workshops, robot system build-outs, open-source robotics hackathons and joint project work.

manifesto.belief: Robotics is essential infrastructure for the future, and developers are the core force driving that future.
goals: Find peers in the same city

values.title: Openness
values.desc: Technology and experience should be shared, not locked away.

values.title: Practice
values.desc: Robotics does not live in papers and concepts; it has to be actually built.

values.title: Open Source
values.desc: ROS succeeded because of its open-source community, and ROS Guangzhou continues that culture.

values.title: Long Term
values.desc: A technical community is not a one-off event, but people connecting and growing together for years.

joinCriteria: You work on robotics, autonomous driving or AI perception
You are simply interested in robotics technology
You want to meet more robotics developers in Guangzhou
